question: (1)/(2) of 4 kg of an alloy is lead and the rest of it is tin. (1)/(6) of 5 kg of another alloy is lead and the rest of it is tin. Find the ratio of lead and tin in the mixture of the given quantities of these two alloys.
solution:
**Calculation:**

1/2 of 4 kg of an alloy is lead and the rest of it is tin.

Quantity of lead in the first alloy = 1/2 ​of 4 kg = 2 kg Eq.(i).

Quantity of tin in the first alloy = 4 - 2 = 2 kg Eq.(ii).

1/6 of 5 kg of another alloy is lead and the rest of it is tin.

Quantity of lead in the second alloy = 1/6 of 5 kg = 5/6 Eq.(iii).

Quantity of tin in the first alloy = 5 − 5/6

(30 - 5)/6 = 25/6 Eq.(iv).

The ratio of lead and tin in the mixture of the given quantities of these two alloys.

Eq.(i) + Eq.(iii) : Eq.(ii) + Eq.(iv)

2 + 5/6 : 2 + 25/6

17/6 : 37/6

17 : 37

**∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.**
